name: Yuuno
source:
A blonde, dignified, and strong-willed princess of Thracia, she is said to have the purest and most beautiful heart in the kingdom.

As the symbol of the Thracian army, she personally takes up arms and goes to the front lines to command the soldiers. Although she is a member of the royal family, she does not abuse her position and treats everyone equally, making her an idol among the soldiers.

She is also a skilled spearman, and her spear technique, which was handed down directly from the royal family, wields a ferocious power. She is a virgin.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/ingoku/]official site[/url]]
